claim_ind48_hma_section8_register.text: Hindu Marriage Act section 8 allows the State Government to make rules for entering marriage particulars in a Hindu Marriage Register, may make entry compulsory in all or specified cases, keeps the register open for inspection, allows certified extracts on application for the prescribed fee, and says omission of entry does not affect the validity of the marriage.

claim_ind48_sma_conditions.text: Special Marriage Act section 4 permits solemnization between any two persons when neither has a living spouse, the statutory capacity conditions are met, the male is at least 21 and female at least 18, and the parties are not within prohibited degrees subject to the stated custom proviso.

claim_ind48_sma_notice_publication_objec.text: Special Marriage Act sections 5–7 require written notice in the Second Schedule form to the Marriage Officer of the district where at least one party has resided for at least 30 days immediately before notice; the officer enters and publishes the notice, and any person may object before expiry of 30 days on a section 4 ground.

claim_ind48_sma_objection_solemnization_.text: Special Marriage Act sections 8 and 9 require the Marriage Officer to inquire into an objection before solemnization, with up to 30 days for the inquiry and a 30-day appeal window from refusal; sections 11–13 require declarations signed by the parties and three witnesses, solemnization before the officer and three witnesses, and a certificate in the Fourth Schedule form signed by the parties and witnesses; section 14 requires a new notice if solemnization does not occur within three calendar months.

claim_ind48_sma_other_forms_registration.text: Special Marriage Act sections 15–16 create a separate registration path for a marriage celebrated in another form: the parties must meet the listed conditions including a ceremony and continued cohabitation, no living spouse, age 21 for both at registration, prohibited-relationship rule and at least 30 days' residence in the Marriage Officer's district; after signed application, public notice and a 30-day objection period, the officer may enter a Fifth Schedule certificate signed by the parties and three witnesses.

claim_ind48_sma_schedules_forms.text: The official Special Marriage Act PDF contains the Second Schedule Notice of Intended Marriage (see section 5), Third Schedule declaration (see section 11), Fourth Schedule Certificate of Marriage (see section 13), and Fifth Schedule Certificate of Marriage Celebrated in Other Forms (see section 16).

claim_ind40_water_act_sewer_permission.text: Section 66 allows an owner or occupier with a private drain to apply, subject to regulations, for communication with a Board sewer, while section 75 prohibits making a connection with a Board sewer without the Board's written permission.

claim_ind40_water_act_rwh.text: Section 72A of the Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Act requires rainwater-harvesting structure for an existing building with sital area of at least 216 square metres and for a proposed building on sital area of at least 108 square metres, subject to notified date, regulations, and Board guidelines.
